purpose: Teach: サタン/羽生/オスカー/クレア/フォックス/魔物/プリーズ/乞食

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハロウィンでサタンのコスプレしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you wore that Satan costume for Halloween, remember?
lines.style: Teasing, playful. Quick delivery with a smirk in the voice. Light jab — she's calling him out in the way only friends do. Slight rise at the end like she's enjoying his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、フィギュアの羽生結弦選手応援してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were obsessed with that Yuzuru Hanyu figurine, Sakura.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact counter. No defensiveness — just turning it back on her with quiet confidence. Steady eye contact in the voice. The smallest smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、映画のオスカー予想で盛り上がってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were going on and on about the Oscar predictions.
lines.style: Quick, accusatory but affectionate. Building slightly — she's enjoying having ammunition. The tone of someone who's been paying attention and is now pleased to prove it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の教科書でクレアって名前出てたな、桜
lines.en: You had that character Claire from the English textbook crush, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, level delivery. Not mean — just factual and unapologetic. The vocal equivalent of a raised eyebrow. Slight pause before her name, letting it land.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、20世紀フォックスの映画好きだったな
lines.en: Riku, you were always going on about those 20th Century Fox movies.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost conversational. The emphasis shifts — she's less 'gotcha' and more 'I noticed you.' Still playful but with an edge of genuine observation underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームで魔物退治してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were grinding through that monster-slaying game all the time, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry acknowledgment. Slight dry humor in the pace — not quite mocking but definitely amused. The tone of someone who watched her do this and found it endearing without saying so.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英会話で「プリーズ」連発してたな
lines.en: Riku, you kept saying 'please' over and over in English class.
lines.style: Sharp, pointed. Quick tempo with a laugh threaded through. She's mimicking his over-politeness slightly. The tone is affectionate mockery — the kind only a close friend can deliver.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で江戸の乞食、つまり物乞い文化習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned about the whole beggar culture thing in Edo period social studies, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact closer. The energy settles slightly — he's made his final point. Quiet confidence. Name lands with finality, like period at the end of a sentence.
